column1: # The TypeScript gates that fail a build. clause<TAB>gate file<TAB># reason
# A TypeScript gate is advisory unless its clause is listed here. A listed
# clause grades like a bash gate: in `warn` mode only a file the branch changed
# fails, in `enforce` mode every file does. Promoting a clause is one row here,
# the `auto` row in docs/index.md and the gate's own test; docs/ratchet.md has
# the recipe. A row whose gate file does not name the clause, or whose clause is
# missing from the index or from the end-to-end test, fails the unit tests.
